about_the_game:
Dive down the Devon Banks and soar along the Dawlish Sea Wall with the legendary Riviera Line for Train Sim World 6. Drive GWR services packed with holidaymakers for idyllic English coastal towns.

Both the Riviera and South Devon Main Lines were built in the mid-1800s. The challenging topography of the land saw rails navigate over hills and cling to coastlines. What followed was instant connections to seaside resorts and the ability to cross some of the most picturesque railway in England; as a result, the line soared in popularity.

Long gone are the days of GWR’s infamous broad gauge and atmospheric railway systems, instead today, the Exeter - Plymouth line is part of the greater, modern UK railway network. The Intercity Express Programme was one such innovation that saw the introduction of bi-mode multiple units to replace fan-favourite High Speed Trains. From this, the Class 802 was introduced, a more powerful, longer-range version of the IEP’s Class 800, designed for better tackling the undulating, distant West Country hills.

In Train Sim World 6, become a driver or conductor aboard GWR intercity and local services, race between Exeter and Plymouth in the Class 802, or take a trip to Paignton from the cab of the Class 150/2. Visit the newly built Marsh Barton station, soak in the sights of the sea, and wind through the hilly countryside.

Key Features


  • 60-mile South Devon Main Line route between Exeter St Davids and Plymouth, including the Riviera Line branch to Paignton
  • Featuring 14 detailed stations, including Marsh Barton, with authentic GWR furnishings, as well as audible passenger announcements
  • BR Class 802/0 and 802/1 BMU in GWR Green livery
  • BR Class 150/2 Sprinter DMU in GWR Green livery
  • Highly detailed, feature-rich, driving cabs
  • True-to-life performance, suspension and handling
  • Accessible Tutorials on the Training Center
  • Audible on-board passenger announcements
  • A number of engaging Scenarios and an authentic timetable, including Guard Mode
  • Journey Mode tying together Training, Scenarios and Timetabled Services
  • Additional timetable layers (each available separately) adding;
    • GWR Class 166 and GWR Class 43 HST services
    • CrossCountry Class 220 services
    • Railtours, RHTT and more!
    • Visible AI steam traffic at Paignton and Totnes for the Dartmouth and South Devon heritage railways
  • Timetable gameplay may be influenced by random events
  • A selection of Route Tasks to complete
  • Explore the route and trains in Free Roam
  • Livery Designer, Formation Designer and Scenario Planner compatible. Share your creations with the Creators Club
  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology
  • Download size: 6.7 GB
